verses.original: ה֧וֹי חֹֽשְׁבֵי־ אָ֛וֶן וּפֹ֥עֲלֵי רָ֖ע עַל־ מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑ם בְּא֤וֹר הַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ יַעֲשׂ֔וּהָ כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־ לְאֵ֖ל יָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ḥō·šə·ḇê- ’ā·wen ū·p̄ō·‘ă·lê rā‘ ‘al- miš·kə·ḇō·w·ṯām bə·’ō·wr hab·bō·qer ya·‘ă·śū·hā kî yeš- lə·’êl yā·ḏām
verses.literal: Woe to those who devise iniquity and plot evil on their beds At morning’s light they accomplish it because the power is in their hands
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que maquinam a iniquidade e planejam o mal nas suas camas! Quando raiar o dia, põem-na por obra, porque está no poder da sua mão.

verses.original: וְחָמְד֤וּ שָׂדוֹת֙ וְגָזָ֔לוּ וּבָתִּ֖ים וְנָשָׂ֑אוּ וְעָֽשְׁקוּ֙ גֶּ֣בֶר וּבֵית֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ וְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·mə·ḏū śā·ḏō·wṯ wə·ḡā·zā·lū ū·ḇāt·tîm wə·nā·śā·’ū wə·‘ā·šə·qū ge·ḇer ū·ḇê·ṯōw wə·’îš wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: They covet fields and seize them they take away houses They deprive a man of his home a fellow man of his inheritance
verses.literalPt: Cobiçam campos e apoderam-se deles; cobiçam casas e arrebatam-nas; eles oprimem um homem e sua casa, a saber, um homem e sua herança.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֛ב עַל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את רָעָ֑ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ תָמִ֨ישׁוּ מִשָּׁ֜ם צַוְּארֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ רוֹמָ֔ה כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî ḥō·šêḇ ‘al- ham·miš·pā·ḥāh haz·zōṯ rā·‘āh ’ă·šer lō- ṯā·mî·šū miš·šām ṣaw·wə·rō·ṯê·ḵem wə·lō ṯê·lə·ḵū rō·w·māh kî ‘êṯ rā·‘āh hî
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD . . . says I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks Then you will not walk so proudly for it will be a time of calamity
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz Jeová: Eis que contra esta família maquino um mal, de que não retirareis as vossas cervizes, e não andareis arrogantemente; pois é este um tempo mau.

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִשָּׂ֧א עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם מָשָׁ֗ל וְנָהָ֨ה נְהִ֤י נִֽהְיָה֙ אָמַר֙ שָׁד֣וֹד נְשַׁדֻּ֔נוּ חֵ֥לֶק עַמִּ֖י יָמִ֑יר אֵ֚יךְ יָמִ֣ישׁ לִ֔י לְשׁוֹבֵ֥ב שָׂדֵ֖ינוּ יְחַלֵּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yiś·śā ‘ă·lê·ḵem mā·šāl wə·nā·hāh nə·hî nih·yāh ’ā·mar šā·ḏō·wḏ nə·šad·du·nū ḥê·leq ‘am·mî yā·mîr ’êḵ yā·mîš lî lə·šō·w·ḇêḇ śā·ḏê·nū yə·ḥal·lêq
verses.literal: In that day they will take up a proverb against you and taunt you with this bitter lamentation We are utterly ruined . . . He has changed the portion of my people How He has removed it from me He has allotted our fields to traitors
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, far-se-á contra vós uma parábola, e se pranteará um pranto lastimoso, e se dirá: Estamos de todo despojados; ele troca a porção do meu povo; como ele a remove de mim! Aos rebeldes reparte os nossos campos.

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ לֹֽא־ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ מַשְׁלִ֥יךְ חֶ֖בֶל בְּגוֹרָ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên lō- yih·yeh lə·ḵā maš·lîḵ ḥe·ḇel bə·ḡō·w·rāl biq·hal Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot
verses.literalPt: Portanto, tu não terás quem meça com cordel uma porção na congregação de Jeová.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּטִּ֖פוּ יַטִּיפ֑וּן לֹֽא־ יַטִּ֣פוּ לָאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖ג כְּלִמּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- taṭ·ṭi·p̄ū yaṭ·ṭî·p̄ūn lō- yaṭ·ṭi·p̄ū lā·’êl·leh lō yis·saḡ kə·lim·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not preach they preach Do not preach these things disgrace will not overtake us
verses.literalPt: Não profetizeis, assim profetizam eles. A estes tais não profetizarão; não cessarão os opróbrios.

verses.original: הֶאָמ֣וּר בֵּֽית־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲקָצַר֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ אֵ֖לֶּה מַעֲלָלָ֑יו הֲל֤וֹא דְבָרַ֨י יֵיטִ֔יבוּ עִ֖ם הַיָּשָׁ֥ר הוֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: he·’ā·mūr bêṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ hă·qā·ṣar rū·aḥ Yah·weh ’im- ’êl·leh ma·‘ă·lā·lāw hă·lō·w ḏə·ḇā·ray yê·ṭî·ḇū ‘im hay·yā·šār hō·w·lêḵ
verses.literal: Should it be said O house of Jacob Is the Spirit of the LORD . . . impatient Are these the things He does Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly
verses.literalPt: Acaso, dir-se-á, ó casa de Jacó: Está estreitado o Espírito de Jeová? São estes os seus feitos? Porventura, não são as minhas palavras salutares ao que anda retamente?

verses.original: וְאֶתְמ֗וּל עַמִּי֙ לְאוֹיֵ֣ב יְקוֹמֵ֔ם מִמּ֣וּל שַׂלְמָ֔ה אֶ֖דֶר תַּפְשִׁט֑וּן מֵעֹבְרִ֣ים בֶּ֔טַח שׁוּבֵ֖י מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ·mūl ‘am·mî lə·’ō·w·yêḇ yə·qō·w·mêm mim·mūl śal·māh ’e·ḏer tap̄·ši·ṭūn mê·‘ō·ḇə·rîm be·ṭaḥ šū·ḇê mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: But of late My people have risen up . . . like an enemy You strip off the splendid robe from unsuspecting passersby like men returning from battle
verses.literalPt: Mas, recentemente, o meu povo se tem levantado como inimigo; de sobre a vestidura arrancais o manto aos que passam em segurança como homens contrários à guerra.

verses.original: נְשֵׁ֤י עַמִּי֙ תְּגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּן מִבֵּ֖ית תַּֽעֲנֻגֶ֑יהָ מֵעַל֙ עֹֽלָלֶ֔יהָ תִּקְח֥וּ הֲדָרִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nə·šê ‘am·mî tə·ḡā·rə·šūn mib·bêṯ ta·‘ă·nu·ḡe·hā mê·‘al ‘ō·lā·le·hā tiq·ḥū hă·ḏā·rî lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: You drive the women of My people from their pleasant homes You take away My blessing from their children forever
verses.literalPt: As mulheres do meu povo, vós as lançais das suas casas agradáveis; de seus filhinhos tirais para sempre a minha glória.

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ וּלְכ֔וּ כִּ֥י לֹא־ זֹ֖את הַמְּנוּחָ֑ה בַּעֲב֥וּר טָמְאָ֛ה תְּחַבֵּ֖ל וְחֶ֥בֶל נִמְרָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·mū ū·lə·ḵū kî lō- zōṯ ham·mə·nū·ḥāh ba·‘ă·ḇūr ṭā·mə·’āh tə·ḥab·bêl wə·ḥe·ḇel nim·rāṣ
verses.literal: Arise and depart for this is not your place of rest because its defilement brings destruction a grievous destruction
verses.literalPt: Levantai-vos e ide-vos embora, pois este não é o vosso lugar de descanso; ide-vos por causa da imundícia que traz destruição, sim, destruição enorme.

verses.original: לוּ־ אִ֞ישׁ הֹלֵ֥ךְ ר֙וּחַ֙ וָשֶׁ֣קֶר כִּזֵּ֔ב אַטִּ֣ף לְךָ֔ לַיַּ֖יִן וְלַשֵּׁכָ֑ר וְהָיָ֥ה מַטִּ֖יף הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lū- ’îš hō·lêḵ rū·aḥ wā·še·qer kiz·zêḇ ’aṭ·ṭip̄ lə·ḵā lay·ya·yin wə·laš·šê·ḵār wə·hā·yāh maṭ·ṭîp̄ hā·‘ām haz·zeh
verses.literal: If a man of wind were to come and say falsely I will preach to you of wine and strong drink he would be just the preacher for this people
verses.literalPt: Se um homem, seguindo o vento e a falsidade, mentir, dizendo: Eu te profetizarei de vinho e de bebida forte; será este tal o profeta deste povo.

verses.original: אָסֹ֨ף אֶאֱסֹ֜ף יַעֲקֹ֣ב כֻּלָּ֗ךְ קַבֵּ֤ץ אֲקַבֵּץ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֥חַד אֲשִׂימֶ֖נּוּ כְּצֹ֣אן בָּצְרָ֑ה כְּעֵ֙דֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַדָּֽבְר֔וֹ תְּהִימֶ֖נָה מֵאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sōp̄ ’e·’ĕ·sōp̄ ya·‘ă·qōḇ kul·lāḵ qab·bêṣ ’ă·qab·bêṣ šə·’ê·rîṯ yiś·rā·’êl ya·ḥaḏ ’ă·śî·men·nū kə·ṣōn bāṣ·rāh kə·‘ê·ḏer bə·ṯō·wḵ had·dā·ḇə·rōw tə·hî·me·nāh mê·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: I will surely gather . . . all of you O Jacob I will collect . . . the remnant of Israel I will bring them together like sheep in a pen like a flock in the midst of its pasture a noisy throng
verses.literalPt: Certamente, te ajuntarei todo, ó Jacó; certamente, congregarei o restante de Israel; pô-los-ei juntos como ovelhas no curral, como rebanho no meio do seu pasto; farão grande estrondo por causa da multidão de homens.

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה הַפֹּרֵץ֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם פָּֽרְצוּ֙ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ שַׁ֖עַר וַיֵּ֣צְאוּ ב֑וֹ וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר מַלְכָּם֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיהוָ֖ה בְּרֹאשָֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lāh hap·pō·rêṣ lip̄·nê·hem pā·rə·ṣū way·ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū ša·‘ar way·yê·ṣə·’ū ḇōw way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr mal·kām lip̄·nê·hem Yah·weh bə·rō·šām
verses.literal: One who breaks open the way will go up before them they will break through the gate and go out by it Their King will pass through before them the LORD as their leader
verses.literalPt: O que abre o caminho subiu adiante deles, romperam, e passaram pela porta, e por ela saíram; o seu rei passou adiante deles, e Jeová em frente deles.
